task.description: Build REQ-005 per docs/agents/design/REQ-005.md (gated PASS). Verify branch: git branch --show-current must equal feature/WF02-REQ005-REQ006 first. Implement exactly per the design: (1) append 'kk' to the locales array in src/i18n/routing.ts, keep defaultLocale 'ru'; (2) create messages/kk.json with the same structure/key-set as messages/ru.json, every value duplicated verbatim from ru.json as a placeholder, including Metadata.ogLocale = 'ru_RU' (a literal placeholder, unlike REQ-003's inferred en_US); (3) do NOT modify src/i18n/request.ts, src/components/landing/LocaleSwitcher.tsx, or src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx -- the design and its gate both independently verified these need no change.
acceptance_criteria: src/i18n/routing.ts's locales array is exactly ["ru", "uz", "en", "kk"], defaultLocale remains "ru"

messages/kk.json exists with identical key structure to messages/ru.json (177 leaf keys, same nesting), every value non-empty; Metadata.ogLocale is "ru_RU"; all other values are the ru.json value duplicated verbatim
Visiting /kk (via npm run build && npm run start) renders <html lang="kk">, and /ru, /uz, /en still render correctly (no regression)
LocaleSwitcher.tsx renders four options and KK navigates correctly to/from /kk/*
Self-review checklist per frontend_developer_guide.md §4 completed (state explicitly this touches no visual code)

result.summary: Added 'kk' to src/i18n/routing.ts's locales array (now ["ru","uz","en","kk"], defaultLocale unchanged at "ru") and created messages/kk.json as a byte-identical copy of messages/ru.json (177/177 leaf keys, verified programmatically to match key-for-key and value-for-value, including Metadata.ogLocale = "ru_RU" per the design's explicit placeholder instruction). request.ts, LocaleSwitcher.tsx, and layout.tsx were left untouched, matching the design's confirmed no-change finding -- no genuine need to touch them was found. npm run lint: 0 errors, 4 pre-existing warnings (Avatar.jsx, Footer.tsx, Nav.tsx img-element and unused-var warnings, none in this diff's files). npm run build: succeeded. Manually verified via npm run build && npm run start: /kk renders <html lang="kk">; /ru, /uz, /en still render <html lang="ru|uz|en"> respectively (no regression); LocaleSwitcher renders 4 links on every locale page (RU/UZ/EN/KK) with correct hrefLang/href/active-state, e.g. on /kk the KK link is class="on" href="/kk" and RU/UZ/EN link out correctly, and on /ru the KK link (hrefLang="kk" href="/kk") is present and correct. This change touches no visual/CSS/component code, so the theme/mobile-desktop/icon/copy-casing checklist items in frontend_developer_guide.md §4 are explicitly not applicable (stated, not silently skipped); lint, build, and no-unrelated-changes items were verified.
